name: expert-video-creator
description: Ten Claude skills that turn an idea, a live web app or a GitHub repo into a finished demo or explainer video: a director that runs discovery (ask-tool interview), app-tester (browses and captures your app or repo), storyboard, asset-builder, voiceover and captions, sound (generated music + SFX), editor (data-driven Remotion template with terminal, code, screenshot, flow and schema scenes in any aspect ratio) and an independent critic, then renders an MP4.
